clue.text: Old college about to introduce programmes involving several language units

indicators.note: POLY and C take the next piece in between them, as if introducing it into their midst

parts.note: a poly is a former polytechnic, a type of British college

explanation.surface: A former polytechnic is about to launch courses that study words of many syllables.
explanation.walkthrough: A poly was a British polytechnic, a college that later became a university; 'about' reads as roughly but is the Latin circa.
explanation.definitionFit: A polysyllabic word has many syllables, and syllables are the units of spoken language.

clue.text: Skulked around before inspiring member of parliament departs

indicators.note: to inspire is literally to breathe in, so PRE takes the bird inside it

explanation.surface: Someone lurked after an MP walked out, seemingly breathing life into the chamber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'member of parliament' wants to be an MP; it is a bird, since a parliament is the collective noun for owls.
explanation.definitionFit: To prowl is to move about stealthily, much as someone skulking does.

clue.text: Discharge rates oddly ignored in contamination of Great Lakes

parts.note: its odd letters R, T, S are the ones removed

explanation.walkthrough: Remove R, T and S (the odd letters of 'rates') from GREATLAKES, then rearrange the remaining GEAALKE.
explanation.definitionFit: A leakage is an escape of liquid, which is a discharge.

clue.text: Her eldest could be mistaken for Lee

explanation.walkthrough: 'Lee' looks like a person's name, but it is the sheltered side of something, away from the wind.
explanation.definitionFit: The lee side of a ship or hill is the side protected from the wind, so it is shielded.

clue.text: Do awful things to note on instrument

clue.text: Having removed source of anxiety, doctor clears up doubt

clue.text: Having chosen tight top and flares with no jacket, put on thin coat

parts.note: elect means chosen, as in the president-elect

parts.note: taken as written

parts.note: without first and last letters this gives LARE

clue.text: Dependent on article found in literature

clue.text: Spin doctor ultimately abandons threatening piece?

explanation.definitionFit: To revolve is to turn round on an axis, as a spinning thing does.

clue.text: Become confused backing up some field data

explanation.definitionFit: To addle is to muddle, and in the intransitive sense to grow muddled oneself.

clue.text: Brilliant deputy head obtains the highest degree, except for one student

clue.text: Foolish lady swallows dubious ruses without question

explanation.walkthrough: 'Foolish' and 'dubious' each signal their own rearrangement, and 'swallows' puts the second result inside the first rather than mixing all nine letters at once.

clue.text: Put back in part of degree lectures

clue.text: Purge has a tendency to divide religious establishment

second meaning: a young or small leaf, or a division of a compound leaf

clue.text: Pick up leads for ecstasy criminals trafficked on county lines

first letter T

clue.text: Part of wall-to-wall coverage includes start of tennis championship
